prompt.v: A, B and D are on circle O, with D on the minor arc AB, and ∠ADB = 100°. What is ∠AOB, in degrees?

problems.explain: An inscribed angle is half the central angle standing on the same arc. ∠ADB stands on the major arc AB, the one away from D, so that arc's central angle is 2 × 100 = 200°. ∠AOB is the rest of the way round: 360 − 200 = 160°. (Doubling 100 gives the major arc, not ∠AOB.) So ∠AOB = 160°.
